attributes.description: opsdir-adapter-adcs (kind pki, declaration-only): importer adcs/inventory reading the shipped PowerShell exporter's typed JSON (ICertView/ICertAdmin2) per CA and the forest's templates LDIF; publication URL flags and variables (urls.py), template LDIF decoding incl. pKIExpirationPeriod (templates.py). Never certutil text, never key columns.
attributes.purpose: Microsoft AD CS read into the core pki domain: CAs, templates, revocation endpoints and issued-certificate inventories, metadata only

attributes.description: Certification authorities (ou=certificate-authorities, with revocation endpoints CDP/AIA/OCSP as children), certificate templates (ou=certificate-templates) and per-CA issued-certificate inventories (ou=issued-certificates, metadata only, never keys) in the core pki domain; the CA hierarchy per certificate (ciamIssuedBy). The record's certificates are reconciled with what their CA issued (fingerprint > serial > subject+validity): present, revoked, revocation-scheduled, superseded, confirmed-missing, inventory-incomplete, inaccessible, not-inventoried; untracked active certificates of templates the record cares about, owned by the template's renewal owner. Planner check check_issued_certificates (estate-wide, silent without an inventory) and reports certificate-authorities and issued-certificates (6.2d).

Microsoft AD CS read into the pki domain's authorities, templates, revocation endpoints and issued-certificate inventory (opsdir-adapter-adcs, importer adcs/inventory, adapter kind pki): per CA a typed JSON export written on the CA host by the shipped PowerShell exporter through the documented ICertView/ICertAdmin2 COM interfaces (issued and revoked rows by schema name, UTC ISO-8601 times, publication URL registry entries as decimal flags:template, the CA's templates), and the forest's certificate templates as LDIF (RFC 2849, base64 binary, pKIExpirationPeriod as a negative 100-ns interval). Metadata only: no archived-key column is ever read. certutil text output is never parsed (6.2d).

attributes.name: template_entry

attributes.name: cert_inventory_entry

attributes.name: issued_entry
attributes.purpose: Importer builder: a ciamIssuedCertificate under a CA's inventory, by request id, from facts of ISSUED_ATTRS

attributes.name: authorities

attributes.name: endpoints

attributes.name: cert_inventories

attributes.name: issued_of
attributes.purpose: The issued certificates of a CA inventory, by request id (numeric order)

attributes.name: authority_of
attributes.purpose: The CA a record certificate was issued by: ciamIssuedBy listed as CA's own certificate, else issuer = CA certificate's subject, else issuer CN = CA name; None for a CA's own certificate

attributes.name: is_revoked
attributes.purpose: Whether the CA recorded an issued certificate as revoked (it carries a reason)

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.purpose: Whether an issued certificate is current on as_of and not revoked

attributes.name: find_issued
attributes.purpose: The issued certificate matching a record certificate: fingerprint (everywhere) > serial > subject+validity (its CA's rows)

attributes.name: newer_issue
attributes.purpose: The latest active certificate issued later to the same subject from the same template (what superseded found)

attributes.name: inventory_name
attributes.purpose: The name of the CA whose inventory holds an issued certificate

attributes.name: reconcile
attributes.purpose: A record certificate's Reconciled state against the CA inventories (present, revoked, revocation-scheduled, superseded, confirmed-missing, inventory-incomplete, inaccessible, not-inventoried), or None when no CA is found

attributes.name: reconciled
attributes.purpose: Every record certificate a CA is found for, reconciled

attributes.name: untracked
attributes.purpose: Active issued certificates no reconciled record certificate was found as: (inventory, issued) pairs

attributes.name: template_of
attributes.purpose: The template entry an issued certificate was issued from, or None

attributes.name: cared_templates
attributes.purpose: Template names the record cares about: renewal owner or purpose recorded, or a record certificate issued from it

attributes.name: renewal_owner
attributes.purpose: Who renews a certificate: record certificate's owners, else its template's ciamRenewalOwner, else None

attributes.name: check_issued_certificates
attributes.purpose: Planner check (estate-wide, silent without an inventory): revoked certificate in use = blocker; revoked unused, scheduled, superseded, missing, unconfirmable, untracked per (CA, cared template), inventoried CA without CRL/OCSP = actions

attributes.name: authority_rows
attributes.purpose: certificate-authorities report rows: config, issued by (hierarchy), CA certificates, templates, endpoints, inventory, owner

attributes.name: issued_rows
attributes.purpose: issued-certificates report rows: each reconciled record certificate, then every untracked active issued certificate

attributes.purpose: DN of a certification authority by name (cn=<name>,ou=certificate-authorities)

attributes.name: template_dn
attributes.purpose: DN of a certificate template by name (cn=<name>,ou=certificate-templates)

attributes.name: issued_inventory_dn
attributes.purpose: DN of a CA's issued-certificate inventory (cn=<CA>,ou=issued-certificates)

attributes.name: row_facts
attributes.purpose: One exported AD CS row's (request id, ciamIssuedCertificate facts or None for an unknown disposition, problems): schema-name columns, zoned ISO 8601 times, revoked rows' effective time and RFC 5280 reason, template resolved

attributes.name: validity_days
attributes.purpose: Whole days of a pKIExpirationPeriod (8-byte signed little-endian negative 100-ns interval), or (None, why not)

attributes.name: read_templates
attributes.purpose: pKICertificateTemplate entries of an LDIF export as {name: display, oid, days, usages} and notices

attributes.name: resolver
attributes.purpose: A function resolving a CA's template value (name, display name or OID) to a template name
